lines.cap: These dogs ran through a blizzard to save a town full of children.
lines.say: These dogs ran through a blizzard to save a town full of children.

lines.cap: Nome, Alaska. January 1925. Children are catching diphtheria, and the town is running out of medicine.
lines.say: Nome, Alaska. January 1925. Children are catching diphtheria, and the town is running out of medicine.

lines.cap: The nearest serum is almost seven hundred miles away. Planes can't fly in this cold.
lines.say: The nearest serum is almost seven hundred miles away. Planes can't fly in this cold.

lines.cap: So twenty mushers and about a hundred and fifty dogs form a relay, through temperatures of minus fifty.
lines.say: So twenty mushers and about a hundred and fifty dogs form a relay, through temperatures of minus fifty.

lines.cap: A husky called Togo leads the hardest stretch. His team runs about two hundred and sixty miles, across cracking sea ice.
lines.say: A husky called Togo leads the hardest stretch. His team runs about two hundred and sixty miles, across cracking sea ice.

lines.cap: Then a dog called Balto leads the final leg, through a whiteout, into Nome.
lines.say: Then a dog called Balto leads the final leg, through a whiteout, into Nome.

lines.cap: Five and a half days. The medicine arrives. The town is saved.
lines.say: Five and a half days. The medicine arrives. The town is saved.

lines.cap: Balto got a statue in New York. Togo, the dog who ran the furthest, was almost forgotten.
lines.say: Balto got a statue in New York. Togo, the dog who ran the furthest, was almost forgotten.
